document.title: SpongeBob Biomes
document.description: Are ya ready, kids? The underwater world of SpongeBob is now a Minecraft Dynamic World where every biome is reimaged with custom generation! Visit Jellyfish Fields, Bikini Bottom, Kelp Forest & more. Eat Krabby Patties, ride Seahorses, use Spatulas to fight and craft your own Krusty Armor! Hang out with familiar SpongeBob characters and take on the Flying Dutchman!

document.title: How to Train Your Dragon
document.description:
This is Berk, home of Vikings and dragons! Join Toothless, Hiccup, and the rest of the dragons and riders on heroic adventures in Minecraft. Compete in racing, map the world, and release captive dragons from invading trappers! Tame, collect, and train dragons from the vast reaches of the Barbaric Archipelago to become an expert dragon rider. 
Includes original skins!

document.title: Aether Legends
document.description:
Build the Aether portal and step into a new dimension in the sky. Befriend new creatures, explore ancient structures, and fight monsters for legendary items. Forge new Aether tools, weapons and armor. Unlock powers like double-jump, glide and more. Face the Slider, Valkyrie Queen and Karthuul.

OFFICIAL collaboration with the Aether Mod team.

document.title: Pale Garden Suburban Home
document.description:
Welcome home! Step over the threshold into your new pale-garden-themed suburban home, nestled deep within a scary custom pale garden forest!

+ Large detailed suburban house with plenty to explore
+ Custom pale garden terrain, vehicles, and textures
+ Two unique modern forest-themed skins

From the team at CrackedCubes

document.title: Abyssal Adventure
document.description:
These treasures have been guarded for ages! Live in a temple that was once submerged by the ocean, explore shipwrecks, and various locations with great loot.

- By Rainbow Theory Studios

document.title: UFO Station
document.description:
Blast off with UFO Station! Explore a massive spaceship floating high in the sky, filled with glowing rooms, winding paths, and hidden surprises.
Jump in, explore, and start your space adventure beyond the clouds!
=> Huge UFO
=> Mob spawners
=> Nether and End portals
=> Hidden chests
=> Outer space adventure 
=> Perfect for role-playing with friends
=> 8 skins, 1 free!

document.title: Ultimate Pale Garden
document.description:
Can you survive the ULTIMATE Pale Garden? Explore eerie locations hidden amongst the trees, haunted by dangerous mobs & chilling secrets. Complete challenging quests to protect the Pale Village, solve puzzles to escape the Pale Mansion & gear up to battle the Hollow Creaking Boss, all enhanced by a sinister custom soundtrack & atmospheric visuals.

From TrixyBlox’s USW 2!

document.title: Dragon Ball Z
document.description: Battle as your favorite Dragon Ball Z character in this explosive DLC! Master iconic moves, battle in legendary arenas from the series, and see who dominates the battlefield.

document.title: Avatar Legends
document.description: You are the Avatar, the embodiment of light and peace, now in Minecraft! Master all four elements and learn new skills from Team Avatar and Team Korra. Meet up with Katara, Zuko, and others while completing quests, explore all four nations from the hit shows, and channel your inner bender with the skins of your favorite characters.

document.title: Firefighter
document.description: Step into the boots of a brave firefighter as you battle raging flames caused by a mysterious Fire Spirit attacking a high-rise building. Use your trusty fire extinguisher or call upon a powerful Water Spirit to douse the inferno. Can you stop the fire spirits before the entire building goes up in smoke?

document.title: Garten of Banban [OFFICIAL]
document.description: The OFFICIAL reimagining of the first Garten of Banban in Minecraft! Explore Banban’s Kindergarten, solve puzzles, and unravel a chilling mystery as you uncover dark secrets. But beware… Horrors lurk in the shadows. Made in partnership with the Euphoric Brothers. Vibrant Visuals is the glow up you’ve been waiting for! See below for the WOW!

document.title: RLCraft Bedrock Edition 1.3
document.description:
RLCraft is here. It's hardcore. It's unforgiving. It's unfair. It's the hardest, most realistic Dynamic World out there! GLHF.

- Explore new world generation with structures & dungeons
- Progress on skills & wield powerful new gear
- Custom player & weapon animations
- Elemental dragons 
- Based on the original RLCraft Modpack by Shivaxi
- You're going to die... a lot

document.title: Skyblock
document.description:
Survive and thrive on the original experience you know and love! Create, expand, and build your world starting from the iconic island that started it all!

The official Bedrock edition of Skyblock created by Noobcrew!

- Includes all versions
- Classic starter chests
- Sand Island + Nether
- Hub for world management
- Pets, Biome Maps, and more!

document.title: University Roleplay
document.description: Roleplay in this super detailed university! Become a professor or start your first day as a student in this top tier school!

document.title: Dream Pastel Furniture
document.description:
Decorate your dream home with 350+ pastel furniture pieces! Choose from many cute styles and color options to create cozy bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, living rooms, and more. Explore ready-made houses or build and decorate your own!

+Perfect for roleplay!

document.title: Stranger Things
document.description:
*sniff, sniff* Do you smell waffles? It must be Netflix's Stranger Things DLC, just in time for the
epic series finale!
Join “The Party” and play as your favorite character, like Will, Dustin, Mike, or Eleven.
characters' unique abilities will help you solve puzzles and vanquish foes. Hop on your bike and
head to the Dressing Room for your free Hellfire Club T-shirt!

document.title: Bluey's House
document.description: Get ready for heaps of fun with Bluey, Bingo, Mum, and Dad! Step inside Bluey’s Family home and play games like I-Spy, Hide and Seek, and Ragdoll. Find the Family’s favourite items to unlock even more games and surprises!

document.title: ONE BLOCK [?]
document.description:
One block + Lucky Block = ONE BLOCK [?]

+ 1.20 blocks
+ Sky block challenge
+ Search lucky blocks one by one

document.title: One Block + (or One Block)
document.description:
One Block + or normal One Block, the choice is yours! You have one goal: mine the block. Explore, survive, and mine your way from nothing! Are you ready for the ultimate one block?
~ 1.21!

document.title: Mega Modern Mansion
document.description: Step into luxury with this Mega Modern Mansion! With over 20+ custom rooms, this massive mansion is perfect for you and your friends to experience the lavish lifestyle!

document.title: Sky Dimensions
document.description:
Travel to TWO new, custom dimensions made of floating sky islands. These are full worlds you actually travel to with unique portals, no fake teleports!

+2 Full Dimensions, 22 Unique Biomes
+400+ Blocks & Items, 40+ Custom Mobs
+Custom World Gen
+Structures, Dungeons, and Bosses
+New powerful Tools, Weapons, & Armor

[!] REAL custom dimensions!

document.title: Trick Shot Tycoon
document.description: Become famous mastering physics-defying trick shots using the new sulfur cubes. Unlock potion effects and enchantments to conquer an insane collection of shots. Challenge friends in co-op to see who has the best aim. Record, playback, and share your clips as you climb to 100k subscribers. Dude, are you ready to nail the perfect trickshot and go viral? Includes 52 skins.

document.title: Sulfur Rush
document.description:
Bounce, dodge, and race your way to victory in Sulfur Rush! Master the jump power mechanic to launch across chaotic obstacle courses in this fast-paced racing minigame. Challenge friends in multiplayer or play solo, and unlock awesome cosmetics for your Sulfur Cube.

+ Single player & multiplayer racing
+ Power-based jumps and parkour obstacles
+ Sulfur Cube cosmetics

document.title: Sulfur Golf
document.description:
Golf with sulfur! Practice your game at the Driving Range, conquer the 9-Hole Course, or beat you friends at Sulfur Minigolf.
- 3 different game modes
- Set the high score at the clubhouse
- Play with up to 8 friends

document.title: Cube Breakers
document.description: Turn one Cube into total chaos! Bounce a Sulfur Cube through block-filled arenas, trigger explosive chain reactions, and spawn even more Cubes! Chase huge combos, master perfect clears, defeat the Ender Dragon in Campaign mode, or survive as long as you can in the endless Infinity mode trial.

document.title: Sulfur Cube TEST LAB
document.description:
Welcome to the Sulfur Cube TEST LAB! Experiment with the Sulfur Cube's unique physics by testing how it interacts with different blocks, surfaces, and obstacles. Once you've mastered the mechanics, jump into exciting minigames like Pool, Football, Golf, Bowling, and more to challenge your friends and put your skills to the test.

By KA Studios

document.title: Random Drops
document.description:
Break a block and get a random item; every drop is random! Dirt could be diamonds. Emerald ore could be rotten flesh! You never know what you will get.
- Seed selector to customize the random drops.
- Share your settings with a friend.
- This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

Will you find the items you need to defeat the Ender Dragon?

document.title: Craftable Mansions
document.description:
- Craft 20 amazing mansions in your survival world!
- The craftable mansions have furniture and vehicles!

Craftable Mansions uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

document.title: Better on Bedrock v1.2.2
document.description:
Explore a new world with Better on Bedrock, a new Dynamic World! There is tons to explore!

• Custom trees, biomes and structure generation
• 100+ New blocks and items
• 20+ New Mobs
• 40+ New Foods & Quests
• 7 New Bosses
• Enjoy custom music and ambiance

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

document.title: Combine Anything [DX] 2.0
document.description:
Unleash your creativity with the Fusion Machine! Combine items to craft unique gear, powerful weapons, and magical tools.
+ Combine ITEMS for NEW creations
+ Craft UNIQUE GEAR and WEAPONS
+ Discover MAGICAL TOOLS
+ Licensed by Eternal Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios
! This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

document.title: Craftable Houses
document.description:
- Use these craftable houses to upgrade your survival world!
- 50+ unique craftable houses decorated with custom furniture!

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

document.title: SURVIVAL BUT NEW CIVILIZATIONS
document.description:
- 120+ new villagers
- 10 new civilizations including in the end, deep dark, and nether 
- 75+ randomly generating new structures
- 25+ custom weapons
- 20 trinkets
- common, rare, epic, legendary, and mythical items

Explore a world of new civilizations!
This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

document.title: Smurfs
document.description: Step into the world of the Smurfs! Gargamel is causing trouble, and it's up to you to save the day. Rescue captured Smurfs, outsmart Gargamel in a potion battle, test your stealth against Azrael, and dash through parkour challenges. Explore Smurf Village to meet iconic characters like Papa Smurf, Smurfette, and Hefty Smurf.

document.title: Dungeons & Dragons: A New Quest
document.description:
Return to the Forgotten Realms in this standalone expansion of Minecraft's Dungeons & Dragons DLC. Experience more of Katra and Vaer's adventures! Battle surprising new enemies, make new friends, and dive back into a rich and full world.
The Dungeons & Dragons DLC is not required to play this content.

document.title: Avatar: Rites of Passage
document.description:
Embark on an exciting journey with the Avatar DLC!
Become a Na’vi of the Omatikaya Clan. Master survival skills and tackle traditional rites of passage. Bond with a banshee, climb the Hallelujah Mountains, and explore the bioluminescent rainforest! Meet breathtaking creatures and plant life along the way.
Includes popular skins!

document.title: Moana 2
document.description: Learn the ways of the ocean with Moana and friends! Explore iconic locations, meet familiar and new characters, and relive moments from both films. Embark on quests around the island while you ride the waves in your canoe, battle the Kakamora, and defeat Tamatoa with Maui.

document.title: Mob Trades
document.description:
Survival but you can trade with every mob! Use Sleepy Orbs to calm hostile mobs and exchange items with them. Each mob offers unique trades based on itself, including items you can't get from normal villagers.

+Custom trades!
+Buy and sell items!
+Career levels that increase by trading!

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

document.title: Billionaire's Pink Mansion
document.description: Live the billionaire dream in pink! Move into a fully furnished modern mega mansion with infinity pools, private sports courts and a rooftop helipad. Explore your yacht, stroll through cherry blossom gardens and relax beside waterfalls. Invite your friends for poolside parties and luxury roleplay in your own pink paradise!

document.title: Pale Garden
document.description:
Explore a NEW MAP filled with new possibilities and CREATE YOUR ADVENTURE within a PALE, GRAY, AND GLOOMY BIOME!

+ Houses, farms, labyrinths, and various places to explore!
- Created by Eco Studios.

document.title: Bad Connection?
document.description: Meeting friends online can be lots of fun, if you know how to spot a bad connection. In this world, learn to recognize tactics that could be used to manipulate you. Play through three high-stakes scenarios, deciding whom to trust and reporting suspicious activity. Explore ways to keep yourself and your community safe and help build a safer Internet for everyone.

document.title: CyberSafe AI: Dig Deeper
document.description: Now is the time to build digital citizenship and AI literacy skills with CyberSafe AI: Dig Deeper! This engaging Minecraft Education adventure challenges students to go beyond the surface and explore AI ethics, critical thinking, and data literacy. Don’t just accept AI at face value. Dig deeper and discover the power of mindful technology use!

document.title: United States
document.description:
Survive in the United States! Learn about notable landmarks and major cities in the USA! 

- Includes 50 states
- Major United States cities
- Furniture included

document.title: Detect & Diagnose
document.description:
Join a medical adventure in Detect & Diagnose!
Get hands on with the amazing equipment that doctors & specialists use every day to track down cancer.
- Track down tumours with CT scans
- Explore the lungs to take a sample of a tumour
- Prepare the sample & analyse it under a microscope

Got what it takes to become a Cancer Detective?


From the Ruth Strauss Foundation

document.title: Reed Smart: AI Detective
document.description: Join Detective Reed Smart to investigate curious cases of AI misuse in this mystery from Minecraft Education! Analyze deepfakes, spot AI-generated content, and learn how AI works as you follow clues and analyze evidence across three cases. Build AI and information literacy skills that will help you get wise and stay cautious of online information. Ready to crack the case?

document.title: Dairycraft
document.description:
Discover the world of dairy farming and milk in this fun, hands-on educational adventure!

+ Large unique open world dairy farm with custom cows
+ Complete six lessons about milk production, farming technology, and life on the farm
+ Unique models, machines and vehicles, including tractors and a crop duster

By CrackedCubes, in association with Dairy Farmers of Ontario

document.title: Our Earth: Europe
document.description:
Take a journey across a stunning, realistic map of Europe. Featuring iconic landmarks and breathtaking natural wonders. 
Visit the grandeur of the Colosseum in Rome, stand in awe of the Acropolis in Athens, marvel at the beauty of the Eiffel Tower in Paris. 
Be a part of an epic Earth project, whether you're adventuring solo or with friends.

document.title: Ocean Heroes
document.description:
Embark on a marine conservation adventure in Ocean Heroes, presented by UNESCO-IOC and Voice of the Ocean! Students will investigate ocean ecosystems and tackle environmental challenges in mangrove forests, coral reefs, and kelp forests. 
Along the way, they’ll encounter amazing creatures, build ocean literacy, and develop critical problem-solving skills.

document.title: Quantum Realm
document.description:
Welcome to a world full of mysteries, where the illogical makes perfect sense! You've accidentally stumbled into a bizarre dimension, and your only way back is to solve 8 mind-bending puzzles!

Nothing is as it seems — Gravity shifts, arrows split, atoms overheat, and much more to uncover on these magical floating islands! Learn to think beyond the ordinary! Think Quantum!

document.title: Life in South America
document.description:
Embark on a journey in this South America themed world as you visit monuments from Colombia to Argentina, Brazil to Ecuador. Mine beneath the surface for rich veins of ore or indulge your wild side to find and tame the legendary capybaras. 
- 11 NEW native mobs
- [UPDATE] 8 land, air, and sea vehicles
- Tame the capybara!
- Rich ore veins above ground

document.title: James Web Space Telescope
document.description: Explore NASA’s groundbreaking work in a dynamic and interactive new way. Engage with exciting, hands-on tutorials that explore the wonders of the James Webb Space Telescope. Learn about star formation, planet characteristics, and galaxy structures then dive into a creative build challenge to create your own solar system.

document.title: Fantastic Fairgrounds
document.description: Discover how to unlock the power of AI with the wondrous world of Fantastic Fairgrounds! Explore AI's impact on everything from blocky beekeeping to the energy of laser lightshows and celebrated creativity in the artists' pavilion. You'll practice the skills to understand, evaluate, and utilize this exciting technology. Shape the future with AI Literacy!

document.title: Happy Family
document.description:
It's family time!
Roleplay with your friends and play in a big blue house that offers everything you need for a good life. Stay in one of the cozy rooms, play outside with your friends or drive with the family car to a picnic. Play as mother, dad, daughter, son, grandpa or grandma. 

- Mansion with over 20 rooms and customized furniture
- A cute family van
- 7 family skins

document.title: Tools Expansion
document.description:
Ever needed a flashlight to discover some dark caves? We've got you! A flashlight, a backpack, and more than 90 other extra useful tools and items have been added to Minecraft in this world! 

New foods, obsidian boats, custom totems, custom weapons, and a grappling hook to enhance your survival experience! 

+ 50 new tools and items!
+ Works in survival and creative!

document.title: Mountainside Mansion 2
document.description:
Life really is better high up in the clouds in this sequel! Do you have what it takes to live on the side of a mountain in luxurious style?

+ Massive modern mansion built into a cliff with a friendly robot
+ Unique custom modern furniture with colour variants
+ Vehicles, custom textures, command automations, and modern skins

From the team at CrackedCubes
